question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word. 

Young, __glamorous__ candidates have typically fared better in general elections.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"glamorous"** means having an attractive or exciting quality that makes certain people or things seem appealing or special. (आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **She looked** glamorous** in her evening gown at the gala.
 
 
 
• **"Repulsive" **refers to something that arouses intense distaste or disgust. (घिनौना)
 
 
• **Example: **The sight of the decaying food was absolutely **repulsive.**
 
 

**The correct answer is option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flashy **(चमकदार): Something that is ostentatious or showy.

 
 
• **Example:** He wore a flashy suit that caught everyone's attention.
 
 
 
• **Attractive **(आकर्षक ): Pleasing or appealing to the senses.
 
 
• **Example: **She has an attractive smile that lights up her face.
 
 
 
• **Alluring** (मोहक): Powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.
